desc: The 3 Conquer 6-24x50 is the scope to help you reach great distance shooting without the normal cost of a distance scope. With Riton HD glass and a First Focal Plane (FFP), illuminated reticle, the 3 Conquer 6-24x50 features exposed, Riton R3 Zero Stop turrets, an integrated throw lever, and a 30mm tube to help break any distance barrier.
